name: warp_tile_lds_coupling
description: When changing warp tile dimensions, always update the matching LDS descriptor and block dims
steps: Read current warp tile (e.g., 32x32 MFMA tile)
When narrowing tile (e.g., 32→16), verify LDS descriptor block width matches
Update block_dim to match the new warp tile count
Narrower tiles inflate MFMA instruction count proportionally — predict PMC impact
expected_impact: avoid silent regression from warp/LDS mismatch
